title: Wire deployment-info semantic readiness to the Runtime DB

phases.objective: Restore canonical Platform Admin semantic readiness in /deployment-info by wiring a lazy query-capable Runtime DB executor while preserving Runtime Persistence DB isolation.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: GET /deployment-info with include_platform_admin_semantic_readiness=1 on the exact deployed Staging SHA.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The route reads workspace_registry through the Runtime DB and reports ready semantic authority without initializing or substituting the Runtime Persistence DB.
steps: Start from the exact reviewed source SHA with the Runtime DB and Runtime Persistence DB remaining separate.
Resolve /deployment-info through the normal registerRoutes composition root.
Inject the lazy runtimeDatabaseReadExecutor as runtimePool.
Query canonical Platform Admin workspace readiness from workspace_registry through the Runtime DB.
Verify the Runtime Persistence DB factory remains isolated and unused for the workspace_registry read.
Require live Staging certification before any promotion decision.
assertions: The server imports getPool separately from getRuntimePersistencePool.
runtimePool is query-capable and lazy: query delegates to getPool().query(...args) without eager getPool() startup initialization.
runtimePersistencePoolFactory remains getRuntimePersistencePool and is never substituted as runtimePool.
deploymentInfoRoutes consumes runtimePool || pool || null for canonical semantic readiness.
The Staging smoke must report ready=true, status=ready, relevant_row_count=1, exact_selector_count=1, marker_candidate_count=1, ready_authority_count=1, and database_read_performed=true.
No database mutation, semantic repair, Production mutation, Gateway mutation, provider mutation, DNS mutation, credential mutation, or grant widening is authorized.
